newsitem.title: UK: UK B/socs net new approvals s/a 3.256 bln in March.
newsitem.headline: UK B/socs net new approvals s/a 3.256 bln in March.

text.p: The UK Building Societies Association (BSA) released the following, seasonally adjusted, data on lending -
MORTGAGE ADVANCES AND NEW APPROVALS TO LEND
NOTES - approval = borrower accepts offer of advance; advance = actual loan, on average some 10 wks after commitment; advances tend to reflect new approvals made 2 or 3 mths ago.
The BSA said the increase in net and gross lending demonstrated that the recovery in the housing market is still on track.

"It is worth noting however that the recovery remains moderate and that spring is traditionally a time when the housing market picks up," said Adrian Coles, Director General of the Building Societies Association.
He said that net advances increased by 44 percent in March compared with February, reflecting the increase in new lending as opposed to remortgaging.

"There are also indications that house prices have been rising and encouraging more sellers into the market. These growing signs of health in the housing market are increasing the prospects for the sutainable growth in lending, transactions and prices to continue throughout 1997," he said.
